scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run check && npm test
scripts.pack:local: npm run build && mkdir -p artifacts && npm pack --workspace @linkoi/core --pack-destination artifacts && npm pack --workspace @linkoi/worker --pack-destination artifacts && npm pack --workspace @linkoi/client --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && wrangler deploy --config deploy/site.jsonc
